name: 24011 · Roanoke, VA
findings: ZIP 24011 (Roanoke) has 46 nonprofit organizations. 15 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 24011 (Roanoke) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 24011 (Roanoke) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 16.2 times the typical level).
